title: Select data-security controls and compliance requirements: concept decisions 1
teachingQuestion: Which layered control set and evidence meet this data state, obligation, and failure path?
focalInsight: Select and tailor complementary controls from scope, data state, architecture, obligation, and operating evidence.
caption: Read across a row to connect meaning, decision and consequence. Use the retrieval answer to check your explanation after reading the linked scenario.

nodes.label: Data Security Controls
nodes.definition: Administrative, technical, and physical safeguards protecting data across states.
nodes.detail: Administrative, technical, and physical safeguards protecting data across states.
nodes.decision: Choose against data state, asset, threat, CIA/privacy need, architecture, owner, evidence.
nodes.failureExample: Encryption is selected while privileged misuse and backups remain uncontrolled.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Controls must cover the failure path.

nodes.label: Compliance
nodes.definition: Demonstrable adherence to applicable contractual, statutory, regulatory, privacy, industry, and organizational duties.
nodes.detail: Demonstrable adherence to applicable contractual, statutory, regulatory, privacy, industry, and organizational duties.
nodes.decision: Map duty, scope, data/location, owner, control, evidence, cadence, exception.
nodes.failureExample: One policy label is presented as proof all obligations are met.

nodes.label: Privacy
nodes.definition: Protection of personal-data processing and related rights/obligations.
nodes.detail: Protection of personal-data processing and related rights/obligations.
nodes.decision: Map purpose, categories, role, location, sharing, retention, rights, breach trigger.
nodes.failureExample: DLP exists but processor contract and retention duty are ignored.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Privacy controls must match processing context.

nodes.label: Layered Controls
nodes.definition: Complementary safeguards reducing reliance on one mechanism.
nodes.detail: Complementary safeguards reducing reliance on one mechanism.
nodes.decision: Combine direction, access, encryption, monitoring, response, recovery, and physical measures.
nodes.failureExample: A single DLP rule is assumed to prevent all disclosure.

nodes.label: Control Assurance
nodes.definition: Evidence that control design and operation meet objective in scope.
nodes.detail: Evidence that control design and operation meet objective in scope.
nodes.decision: Test coverage, configuration, operation, exceptions, monitoring, and residual risk.
nodes.failureExample: A CASB is purchased but no logs show policy operation.

nodes.label: Digital Rights Management
nodes.definition: Persistent usage restrictions on supported protected content.
nodes.detail: Persistent usage restrictions on supported protected content.
nodes.decision: Use when authorized-recipient actions need controlled rights and key management.
nodes.failureExample: DRM is assumed to stop screen capture or unsupported-client copying.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: DRM limits specified use but has coverage limits.

nodes.label: Data Loss Prevention
nodes.definition: Discovery, monitoring, alerting, or blocking of policy-defined sensitive-data movement.
nodes.detail: Discovery, monitoring, alerting, or blocking of policy-defined sensitive-data movement.
nodes.decision: Tune identifiers, channel, exceptions, response, and evidence.
nodes.failureExample: DLP blocks legitimate encrypted transfer with no exception path.

nodes.label: Cloud Access Security Broker
nodes.definition: Visibility and policy mediation for cloud-service use through supported integration paths.
nodes.detail: Visibility and policy mediation for cloud-service use through supported integration paths.
nodes.decision: Check service support, identity, deployment mode, traffic path, policy, logs.
nodes.failureExample: CASB is assumed to see unsanctioned direct cloud traffic it does not integrate with.

nodes.label: Tailoring
nodes.definition: Documented modification/supplement of a baseline for context while managing residual risk.
nodes.detail: Documented modification/supplement of a baseline for context while managing residual risk.
nodes.decision: Record baseline, scope rationale, owner/approval, inherited or compensating control, parameter, evidence, review.
nodes.failureExample: Control is silently removed because it seems inconvenient.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Tailoring is a governed risk decision.
